summary: version test options: left-hand input, operator (==, <, >=, !=, etc.; default eq), strict, required right-hand version, and version_type (loose default).
questions: What operators does the version test support?
How do I compare using semantic versioning?
Can I use strict and version_type together?

answer_card.title: version test parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input`: left version; `version`: right version (both required)
- `operator` (eq): `==`, `=`, `eq`, `<`, `lt`, `<=`, `le`, `>`, `gt`, `>=`, `ge`, `!=`, `<>`, `ne`
- `version_type` (loose): `loose`, `strict`, `semver`, `semantic`, `pep440`
- `strict` (false): mutually exclusive with `version_type`
